question: The word "eclectic" means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (4)** i.e. Drawing ideas from many sources.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Eclectic** means having a diverse range of sources, styles, or ideas. It typically refers to an approach that combines elements from a variety of different cultures, genres, or methodologies. (विविध स्रोतों से विचार लेना)

 
 
• **Example: **Her music taste is eclectic, ranging from classical to jazz to hip-hop.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Drawing ideas from many sources**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained:

 
• **Expensive** (महंगा):

 
 
• This word means costing a lot of money.
 
• **Example: **The luxury car was quite expensive.
 
 
 
• **Carefully chosen** (ध्यानपूर्वक चुना हुआ):
 
 
• This phrase means selected with attention and care.
 
• **Example: **The ingredients for the recipe were carefully chosen.
 
 
 
• **Purely traditional** (केवल पारंपरिक):
 
 
• This phrase means strictly adhering to traditional or established ways.
 
• **Example: **The ceremony was purely traditional, with no modern elements.
 
 

44:Tc76,

The correct answer is: **Option 3) Skill in making things**.
